q: What goes into a two-wheeler service centre's Scope 1 and Scope 2?
title: Two-wheeler service centres: scopes
short: Scope 1 covers fuel you burn, such as diesel in a generator and petrol used for test rides on vehicles you control. Scope 2 is grid electricity for lifts, compressors and washing. Oil and parts you buy are Scope 3.
audience: Two-wheeler dealer workshops and service centres

p: Generator diesel at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre.
Petrol for workshop and test-ride use, from the fuel log.
Grid kWh x 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25.
Engine oil, parts and consumables bought, and waste oil sent for recycling.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
